newsitem.title: KENYA: Tea prices hold firm on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices hold firm on strong demand.

text.p: Tea prices held firm at the weekly Kenyan auction on strong demand, auction officials said.
Brighter and medium BP1s were fully firm to 5 U.S. cents dearer, while lower mediums rose by upto 2 cents. Brighter PF1s were irregular with quality but on balance gained 4 cents.
Mediums were dearer by 4 cents while Brighter DUST1s appreciated by 4-8 cents.
On average Brighter fannings and Dusts gained value.
There was strong demand from Pakistan, Egypt and the Sudan with good line orders for North America and South Africa.
